2609.30219.title: Requirement-Bound Verified Commissioning: A Frozen Four-Billion-Parameter Local Model as a Candidate Generator under an External Acceptance Layer with Verification and Release Authority
2609.30219.paper_summary: An acceptance protocol is developed for sensor-coordinate and polarity binding in mechatronic commissioning. Candidate generation is separated from release authority. Requirements unsupported by a deterministic parser are routed to a frozen local language model with four billion parameters. Plans are released only when both facts can be derived by an external gate under a sealed grammar. One canonical answer is requested from a gold-standard user when eligible. The protocol was evaluated once under a criterion fixed before benchmark construction, on 144 tasks written by isolated agent contexts without access to the gate, grammar, or experimental plan. Three contributions are established. First, candidate generation and release decisions were measured separately. Fabricated ready plans were committed on 21 of 22 routed unanswerable tasks, and all were rejected. The same 83 releases were reproduced without model calls. Second, no false release was observed among 83 releases. A one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound of 0.0354 was obtained as a diagnostic under an independent-and-identically-distributed assumption, below the sealed 5% threshold. However, one false release was subsequently recorded among 146 releases outside the benchmark at seed 0. Third, protection against incorrect user answers was characterized. Both facts were bound from the original text on 13 of 96 answerable tasks. Incorrect answers were released in 169 of 431 pairings on the remaining tasks, including failures involving coordinate exclusion. A deployable questioning policy was not tested because eligibility was determined from the answer key. Gate sensitivity and real user behavior were not measured.
2609.30219.paper_summary_zh: 一個接受協議被開發用於機電調試中的傳感器坐標和極性綁定。候選生成與發布權限分開。對於不被確定性解析器支持的要求，則路由到一個擁有四十億參數的凍結本地語言模型。只有當兩個事實都可以在密封語法下由外部閘門推導時，計劃才會被發布。當符合條件時，會向黃金標準用戶請求一個標準答案。該協議在基準構建之前固定的標準下進行了一次評估，針對144個由孤立代理上下文編寫的任務，這些上下文無法訪問閘門、語法或實驗計劃。建立了三個貢獻。首先，候選生成和發布決策是分開測量的。在22個路由的無法回答的任務中，有21個製作的準備計劃被提交，所有計劃都被拒絕。相同的83個發布在沒有模型調用的情況下被重現。其次，在83個發布中未觀察到虛假發布。在獨立且同分佈假設下，獲得了0.0354的一側95% Clopper-Pearson上限，低於密封的5%閾值。然而，在基準之外的146個發布中，隨後記錄了一次虛假發布。第三，對不正確用戶答案的保護進行了特徵描述。在96個可回答任務中，有13個任務的兩個事實是從原始文本中綁定的。在剩餘的任務中，431對配對中有169次發布了不正確的答案，包括涉及坐標排除的失敗。未測試可部署的提問政策，因為資格是根據答案鍵確定的。閘門敏感性和真實用戶行為未被測量。
